paragraphs.text:
With an effort of will, you hold yourself together. Bernard does 
not. Terrorized, he hobbles away on his injured ankle.

To follow him, go to 624. To stand firm with Norman and Sylvia 
and greet the creatures as if they were primitive men, go to 626.
